title: Internship Background Check
scenario: A company asks for passport, birthdate, and bank details before interview.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Internship Background Check: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Sensitive data should not be collected before a verified offer process.
